title: The Point of No Return
narration: Pull up a chair. We're going to a place where time stops, light bends, and every path collapses into one silent point—a black hole.
visual_goal: Ultra-close render of event horizon, light bending into dark void.

title: The Cosmic Echo
narration: In twenty fifteen, two black holes smashed together a billion light-years away. The shockwave traveled all that way, shaking a machine on Earth—and became a sound.
visual_goal: Two spheres spiral, collide, ripples in dark fabric.

title: The Shadow of a Giant
narration: Sound tells us black holes exist. But seeing one requires a telescope the size of Earth. In twenty nineteen.
visual_goal: Fade to iconic EHT orange ring with dark center.

title: The Lightest Touch
narration: But black holes are not forever. In nineteen seventy-four, Stephen Hawking showed they leak radiation—a faint glow from the edge of the event horizon itself.
visual_goal: Small black hole, faint particles escaping and dimming.

title: The Hidden Core
narration: And this isn’t just some distant theory. In nineteen sixteen, Karl Schwarzschild first described these objects using Einstein’s equations.
visual_goal: Pan from Sagittarius A* to Milky Way galaxy zoom-out.
